Follow all coding standards in [docs/AGENT-STANDARDS.md](../docs/AGENT-STANDARDS.md). Edit that file only when conventions change.

Quick reminders: English for code/files/`_type`; Spanish for Studio labels and user-facing copy. Fixed pages only — Inicio (`/`) and Portafolio (`/portfolio`). Seed via `sanity/lib/page-seed.ts` / `npm run seed:pages`. Header nav is curated in site settings; section anchors use `resolveSectionId` + optional Ancla. New blocks: schema → `documents/page.ts` → `pageByIdQuery` → `components/page-builder/blocks` → `PageBuilder.tsx` (+ seed/anchors/media-cleanup as needed).
